Join the team that protects our world - and be part of building something exciting 😊
 As part of APi Group, Chubb Fire & Security helps protect millions of people, buildings and critical assets around the world. From hospitals and schools to airports, commercial buildings and essential infrastructure, our work helps safeguard the environments people rely on every day.
 Now, we are building our Europe Capability Centre in Bucharest and looking for talented professionals who want to be part of something from the very beginning.
 This is more than just a new job or a new team. It is an opportunity to help create, influence, upgrade, digitalize, optimize processes while also contributing to the culture as ways of working that will define who we are. Your ideas, experience, and perspective will play an important role in how we collaborate, learn and support each other.
 We want to create an environment where collaboration, ownership, continuous learning and improvement and wellbeing are at the heart of how we work. We believe that growth can happen in all directions - through new responsibilities, new skills, cross-functional opportunities, international exposure and the chance to contribute beyond your immediate role. No matter your position, your ideas, experience and ambitions can help shape both your own career and the future of the organization.
 If what we are building resonates with your ambitions, values and aspirations for the future, we would love to hear from you 🌟
 About the Role 
 As part of the Shared Services Center, the Helpdesk Support Specialist is responsible for handling supplier inquiries related to invoices and payments, providing timely support, coordinating issue resolution with internal stakeholders, and contributing to an efficient and high-quality supplier experience. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 The main responsibilities include in particular:
Communicate directly with suppliers via email and phone to clarify requests related to invoices, payments, and account status
Investigate delayed payments and blocked invoices by coordinating with relevant internal teams
Provide suppliers with accurate and timely updates regarding invoice processing and payment status
Coordinate with Accounts Payable and Payments teams to resolve outstanding issues and ensure effective follow-up
Monitor and manage supplier requests through the Helpdesk process, ensuring timely resolution in line with service level commitments
Escalate complex issues when required and ensure proper tracking until final resolution
Contribute to process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing supplier satisfaction
Maintain professional and constructive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders
 Technical Skills 
 The candidate is expected to have the following skills:
Understanding of Accounts Payable processes, including invoice processing and payment cycles
Ability to investigate invoice and payment-related issues and identify root causes
Experience in customer service, supplier support, or helpdesk activities
Ability to manage multiple requests while maintaining high-quality service standards
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and ERP systems (SAP experience is considered an advantage)
 Soft Skills 
Strong customer and supplier service orientation
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities
Reliability and adherence to procedures and deadlines
Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently
Proactivity, adaptability, and ability to manage priorities effectively
Ability to work collaboratively within a multicultural and international environment
Professionalism, diplomacy, and resilience when handling challenging situations
 Candidate Profile 
 Education / Qualification 
 Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
 Language Skills 
 Given the regular interactions with suppliers and stakeholders, fluency in French at a minimum B2 level is mandatory. 
 English language proficiency is also required for internal communication and collaboration.
 Experience 
Previous experience in Accounts Payable, Supplier Support, Customer Service, Helpdesk, or Shared Services environments is highly valued
Experience working with supplier-facing activities and issue resolution processes is considered an advantage
Experience in an international environment is a plus
 Additional Information 
 APi Group is a global, market-leading business services company providing statutorily mandated and contracted services across its Safety Services and Specialty Services segments, including fire and life safety, electronic security, elevator and escalator, and infrastructure services. With more than 600 locations in over 20 countries, APi is built on a century of expertise, a people-first culture, and its purpose of Building Great Leaders®. In 2026, Api Group is celebrating its 100-year anniversary and its debut as a Fortune 500 company. More information is available at apigroupinc.com
